## Question
What would you like to know or what help do you need?

## Context
Provide any relevant context:
- What are you trying to accomplish?
- What have you tried so far?
- What documentation have you read?

## Environment
- OS: [e.g., Windows 11, macOS 12.1, Ubuntu 20.04]
- Python Version: [e.g., 3.9, 3.10]
- VRChat MCP Version: [e.g., 0.1.0]
- VRChat Version: [if applicable]

## Additional Information
Any additional information that might be helpful:
- Configuration files
- Error messages
- Screenshots
- Logs

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing documentation
- [ ] I have searched existing issues
- [ ] This is not a bug report (use bug report template instead)
